subject: Request: program credit governance & eligibility for LaunchRise cohort
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@launchrise.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@launchrise.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: program credit governance & eligibility for LaunchRise cohort

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — very impressed with Redwood's latency profile. LaunchRise is finalizing the cohort benefits and we are putting together a short list of technical partners for the 2027 Spring batch. Two asks from our side: 

1) Eligibility check: can Redwood extend a cohort package (pilot credits + 6-week trial extension) that covers activity up to 500M tokens for up to 10 teams? We want to ensure startups can run realistic workloads (embedding + chat).

2) Governance note: we need a short compliance summary (SOC 2 scoping, data retention defaults, and whether any usage telemetry leaves customer VPCs for the Private offer). Attached is our one-pager with typical program milestones.

Can you advise next steps and whether a commercial approval path is needed (legal/finance signoff)? We’re targeting cohort kickoff on May 3.

Best,
Samir
Founder, LaunchRise
Attachment: LAUNCHRISE_PROGRAM_ONE_PAGER.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@launchrise.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: program credit governance & eligibility for LaunchRise cohort

Samir —

Thanks for the overview and for sharing the one-pager. Short answers up-front: yes, we can support a cohort package at that scale, and we can provide the compliance summary you're asking for. There are two decision points on our side:

- Commercial scope: whether this is a promotional credit (no SLA) or a sponsored pilot tied to a Reserved/Dedicated credit commitment.
- Terms & approvals: Legal/Finance need to sign off if we extend credits beyond our standard trial limits (internal approval required).

Next steps I propose: 
- I'll run a quick eligibility & impact calc with Aditya (sales) to confirm token budget and expected demo behavior.
- Monica (CS) — could you prepare a short Runbook for cohort onboarding (KV cache recommendations + suggested prompt-set limits)?
- I'll loop-in Laura from Legal for a light review of the governance note and any PO/contract requirements.

Provisional timeline: I’ll send a recommended package and required approvals by Friday 4/9. If that works on your end we can lock a conditional credit offer that we finalize once legal signs off.

—Mateo
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: program credit governance & eligibility for LaunchRise cohort

Matt/Aditya — posting initial runbook notes here so we have internal alignment before I share with LaunchRise:

- Suggested starter profile: 10 teams, 50M tokens/team (500M total) spread across embeddings-heavy indexing week + chat-based assistant weeks. Plan for 80/20 embeddings/chat.
- Performance guidance: set batching window to 25ms for chat endpoints, enable prefix caching for shared system prompts across cohort projects.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 summary attached; default retention is 30 days for ephemeral request logs on Hosted API (can be extended on Dedicated/Private).
- Onboarding attachments: sample MAP (mutual action plan) and a short checklist for startups.

I'll share a one-page Runbook and the MAP (attached) once Aditya confirms the credit sizing and commercial framing.

Cheers,
Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-MAP-v1.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB); SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF, 75KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: program credit governance & eligibility for LaunchRise cohort

All — quick commercial note after doing a cost estimate: 500M tokens on Hosted API at standard promo rates would be approximately $24k — that fits within our promotional budget for a flagship cohort but requires "C-level approval" for sponsored credits > $20k.

Recommendation: offer a conditional package: $25k in promotional credits (covers expected overage & buffer) + a 6-week trial extension, with the following guardrails:
- Promo credits redeemable only for model family 'redwood-1' and embeddings endpoints
- Usage telemetry retention remains at default 30 days for Hosted; customers can opt for Dedicated/Private with standard procurement.

Laura — can you confirm if a signed promotional addendum (short form) is sufficient for finance to process or if we need a PO from LaunchRise?

If legal signs off by EOD Monday we can send a conditional offer to Samir and Elena and lock in the cohort kickoff.

Thanks,
Aditya
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
